A FEW DETAILS

Before you add
TabTools.

Something else on your mind?
Get in touch.

Is TabTools free?

Yes. TabTools is free to use. Its source code is available on GitHub.

Which browsers can I use it in?

TabTools is available for desktop Chrome, Firefox and Microsoft Edge. The Chrome Web Store listing is linked below.

How do I close tabs from the same website?

In Firefox, right-click a tab and choose “Close site tabs”. In Chrome and Edge, right-click within the page and choose the same command. You can also enter the site’s domain in the TabTools popup.

Can I remove duplicates or clear inactive tabs?

Yes. Use the popup’s duplicate cleanup action to remove repeated tabs. For inactive tabs, choose an inactivity threshold in Settings, then run cleanup yourself.

What information does the extension store?

It stores preferences, such as your theme and suggestion thresholds, and cleanup statistics locally. Open-tab information is processed on your device. See the extension privacy policy for details.
